title: AnalystPriceTargetSchema
description: Institutional schema for sell-side analyst research reports, price targets, announcement market prices, and consensus analytics.

symbol.description: Stock symbol for the price target (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT).

analyst_name.description: Name of the sell-side research analyst issuing the price target.

firm.description: Investment bank, brokerage, or research institution (e.g. Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Wedbush).

announcement_date.description: Date target was officially published or announced (YYYY-MM-DD).

market_price_at_announcement.description: Market closing or prevailing price of the stock as of the announcement date in USD.

target_price.description: Analyst target price per share in USD.

implied_upside_pct.description: Implied percentage upside or return from the announcement market price to the target price.

report_title.description: Title or headline of the analyst research report.

source_url.description: Direct URL or locator to research note or aggregator release.
